about: 🕊 What would Jesus do? Life situations for the phone's Search page, written by hand. Each holds references only, never verse text: what Jesus said (shown in red where the King James marks His words), what Jesus did, and more from Scripture. The headings are BibleChat's words, not Scripture. packaging/build_situations.py checks every reference against the Bible files and writes web/situations.json.

did.point: He slept in the storm, then rose and calmed it with a word
He came to His frightened disciples on the water: "It is I; be not afraid"

verses.point: Bring every care to God in prayer, and His peace will keep your heart
God is with you; you do not face it alone

situations.title: Grief and the death of someone you love

did.point: He wept at the grave of His friend Lazarus
He had compassion on a grieving widow and gave back her son

verses.point: We grieve, but not as those who have no hope
The LORD is near the brokenhearted; one day He wipes away every tear

situations.title: Money troubles and losing a job

did.point: He fed five thousand with five loaves and two fishes
He taught us to ask the Father for our daily bread

verses.point: God supplies every need; be content with what you have
Work honestly, owe no one anything but love

did.point: When He was reviled, He did not revile again
His zeal for His Father's house: He drove out those who made it a house of merchandise

verses.point: Be slow to wrath; a soft answer turns it away
Be angry and sin not; let not the sun go down on your wrath

did.point: On the cross He prayed for those who crucified Him
He washed the feet of all His disciples, Judas too, then gave them a new commandment

verses.point: Forgive as God in Christ forgave you
Do not take revenge; leave it to God and overcome evil with good

situations.title: Enemies, and people who mock my faith

did.point: When He was accused before Pilate, He answered nothing
When a village would not receive Him, He rebuked the disciples who wanted fire from heaven, and went on

verses.point: Bless them that persecute you; feed your enemy
Suffering as a Christian is no shame

did.point: His friends forsook Him and fled in His darkest hour
He went to the outcasts no one would eat with: Zacchaeus, and the woman at the well

verses.point: He will never leave you nor forsake you
God sets the solitary in families; nothing can separate you from His love

did.point: He touched the leper and said, "I will; be thou clean"
He healed all who came to Him

verses.point: Is any sick? Call the elders; the prayer of faith
His grace is sufficient; by His stripes we are healed

did.point: Tempted in the wilderness, He answered each temptation with "It is written"
In Gethsemane He watched and prayed, and told His disciples to do the same

verses.point: God makes a way to escape; He knows our weakness
Resist the devil and he will flee; walk in the Spirit

did.point: After Peter denied Him three times, He asked him three times, "Lovest thou me?" and gave him work to do
He told a woman who washed His feet with tears, "Thy sins are forgiven"

verses.point: Confess, and He is faithful and just to forgive
No condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus

did.point: His first sign was at a wedding: He turned the water into wine
He loved the church and gave Himself for it: the pattern for a husband

verses.point: Love is patient and kind, keeps no record of wrong
Husband and wife: love, honour, and do not be bitter

did.point: His own brothers did not believe in Him
From the cross He gave His mother into the care of John

verses.point: Honour father and mother; fathers, provoke not your children
As much as lies in you, live peaceably with all

situations.title: Doubt, and when God seems silent

did.point: When a father cried, "Help thou mine unbelief", Jesus healed his son
When Peter began to sink, He stretched out His hand and caught him
On the cross He cried, "My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?"

verses.point: Ask for wisdom without wavering; draw near to God
Wait on the LORD; the psalmists asked "How long?" too

situations.title: Despair, depression and no hope

did.point: In Gethsemane His soul was exceeding sorrowful, even unto death; He prayed, and an angel strengthened Him
He walked with two downcast disciples on the road to Emmaus

verses.point: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? Hope thou in God
Elijah wanted to die; God gave him sleep, food and a still small voice
His mercies are new every morning

situations.help: If you are thinking about ending your life, please call or text 988 now (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, in the USA), or your local emergency number. You are not alone.

did.point: Before choosing the twelve, He continued all night in prayer
Facing the cross, He prayed, "Not my will, but thine, be done"

verses.point: Trust in the LORD with all your heart; He shall direct your paths
Ask God for wisdom; in a multitude of counsellors there is safety

did.point: He rose a great while before day and went to a solitary place to pray
Wearied from His journey, He sat by the well and rested

verses.point: They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength
He gives His beloved sleep; cast your burden on the LORD

situations.title: Conflict with a neighbour, coworker or boss

did.point: When His disciples argued who was greatest, He took a child and taught them to serve
He told Peter to put away his sword, and healed the servant's ear

verses.point: Live peaceably; a soft answer turns away wrath
Work as for the Lord; speak no evil of anyone

did.point: He ate with publicans and sinners, and answered those who murmured
To the woman taken in adultery: "Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more"

verses.point: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant?
Restore one another gently, considering yourself

did.point: When they wanted to make Him king by force, He departed into a mountain alone
He washed His disciples' feet and said, "I have given you an example"

verses.point: Pride goes before destruction; God gives grace to the humble
Godliness with contentment is great gain

situations.title: Tempted to lie or cut corners

did.point: Zacchaeus met Jesus and gave back fourfold what he had taken
He paid the tribute money for Himself and Peter, lest they offend

verses.point: Lie not one to another; speak truth with your neighbour
Lying lips are an abomination; the integrity of the upright guides them

situations.title: Someone in need: should I help?

did.point: Moved with compassion, He fed the hungry crowd
He stopped for blind Bartimaeus when others told him to be quiet

verses.point: Faith without works is dead; love in deed and in truth
He that gives to the poor lends to the LORD; be hospitable to strangers

did.point: He talked with a Samaritan woman at a well, and her whole town came to hear Him
He sent a healed man home: "Go home to thy friends, and tell them"

verses.point: Be ready always to give an answer, with meekness and fear
Not ashamed of the gospel: the power of God unto salvation

did.point: He rose from the dead and showed Himself alive
As He died, He committed His spirit into His Father's hands

verses.point: O death, where is thy sting? Christ delivers those who feared death
Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death

situations.title: Waiting, and things not going my way

did.point: When He heard Lazarus was sick, He waited two days, for the glory of God
"Mine hour is not yet come"

verses.point: All things work together for good to them that love God
Wait on the LORD; be of good courage
